label: Hands On
description: Learn by doing. Move a curve, place the bands on a gel, knock out part of a pathway, choose the controls, read a spectrum, find the error or sort the ideas. You commit to a guess first, then see the real result beside it. Private study pack: the activities come from university course material.
tagline: Guess first. Then turn the dials.
author: Private pack: its content comes from university course material

settings.label: How hard to ask
settings.description: Normally each topic starts easy and moves up as you get rounds right: which way it goes, then how far, then the number with its unit. Choose one to stay on it.
